files.name: Slack como Agentic OS & Agentforce 360 — Catálogo Estratégico Consolidado (ES) (Claude)
files.summary: Comprehensive strategic catalog consolidating Slack as an Agentic OS integrated with Agentforce 360, detailing 21 business epics, user-centric use cases, L1-L3 process hierarchies, and rigorous financial/operational value architecture across sales, service, knowledge management, and enterprise governance. Addresses systemic fragmentation via conversational AI orchestration, MCP-based interoperability, and native Salesforce Customer 360 integration to eliminate context-switching friction (Toggle Tax) and compress operational latency.

Using Slack AI Channel Recaps to synthesize 6 months of historical messages into instant narrative summary with hyperlinked citations for account context
Expanding Agentforce Sales Sidebar in Slack to view risks, receive next-best-action recommendations, and update Opportunity fields without form-filling or toggling
Recording asynchronous Slack Clip with screen capture to demonstrate integration error, enabling distributed team to troubleshoot in their timezone without formal meeting
Routing MCP Server traffic through MuleSoft Omni Gateway to enforce rate-limiting and threat detection on LLM queries to ERP systems
Activating Tableau Pulse Digests to receive automated weekly revenue analytics summary in Slack with AI-generated win-rate insights and regional performance breakdown
Deploying Employee Agent using Onboarding Agent template to guide new hires through knowledge base and auto-generate personalized onboarding Canvas

Editing PagerDuty/Asana Work Objects inline from Slack message to mark tasks complete or update due dates without opening browser tab

Invoking Real-time Search API from MCP Client to locate PDF contract shared 6 months ago in private channel and extract grounding facts for LLM response
Configuring Slack Sales Home to display curated KPIs, Salesforce Lists, and deal-won celebration notifications for sales team motivation and pipeline visibility
Designing Slack Record Layout to restrict visible/editable Opportunity fields in Sales Home, preventing information overload and unauthorized mutations
Triggering /service-help command to initiate Swarm, auto-create dedicated channel, instantiate Swarm/SwarmMember objects, and convoke subject-matter experts
Deploying Slack MCP Server with strict OAuth scopes to allow Anthropic Claude external AI to search conversational history while respecting RBAC permissions
Creating hybrid Salesforce Flow + Slack Workflow Builder automation to alert executive committee for discount approval when opportunity reaches critical stage
Embedding live Salesforce CRM fields (Account Health, Pipeline Stage, Renewal Date) in Slack Canvas to keep strategy document perpetually synchronized with source system
Configuring Enterprise Key Management (EKM) on AWS KMS to grant CISO absolute cryptographic control; revoking channel encryption instantly blocks AI and human access
Deploying Project Tracker template in Slack Lists to map tactics, assign owners, modify due dates, and trigger automated notifications without leaving chat
Creating dedicated channel linked to Salesforce Account record via Salesforce Channels to unify team discussions with live CRM notifications
Using Expert Finder for Swarming to algorithmically match support ticket product/failure type with certified engineer and auto-add to incident channel
Configuring Deal Won Celebration to display victory banner on rep's profile for 3 days, gamifying sales culture and driving peer-motivated win-rate lift
Activating Slack Huddles for real-time audio/video screen-sharing and collaborative drawing to resolve complex technical issues with distributed team
Setting up Slack AI Enterprise Search to find meeting notes, Canvases, and policies using natural language queries across entire workspace
Mapping SAML NameID and Permission Sets to enforce zero-trust access control, ensuring only validated sales users can mutate Opportunity records from Slack
Deploying Slack Sales Elevate to compress sales cycle by allowing reps to update pipeline, view quota, and receive instant notifications without CRM portal login
Integrating Slack as MCP Server to grant external AI assistants (Claude, Perplexity) secure, audited access to corporate knowledge without data exfiltration risk

files.name: Arquitectura Estratégica Avanzada y Análisis de Valor: Slack como Sistema Operativo Agéntico (Agentic OS) & Agentforce 360
files.summary: Comprehensive strategic architecture document analyzing Slack as an Agentic Operating System (Agentic OS) integrated with Salesforce Agentforce 360, detailing five sections: Business Epics, User Use Cases, L1/L2/L3 Process Maps, Value Architecture by Use Case, and Process Value Architecture. files.name: Strategic Catalog of Epics and Use Cases: Slack as a Digital HQ
